blocks.text: NAGA CITY, Philippines — The Philippine Anti-Corruption Czar (PACC), a civil society watchdog, is investigating the stalled construction of the Naga City Convention Center in Barangay Carolina after an inspection revealed rusting steel structures and vegetation covering the project site.
